key_insight: SevenNet-Polar extends an equivariant GNN to predict Born effective charges alongside energy, forces, and stress, delivering fast, accurate charge-aware atomistic modeling for field-coupled materials.
engineering_relevance: The model makes electric-field and polarization-related simulations more practical for perovskites and oxide materials by replacing expensive BEC calculations with GPU-scalable predictions.
method: Equivariant SevenNet-based graph neural network for multitask atomistic prediction
Separate BEC-only and all-in-one models for energy, forces, stress, and BEC
FlashTP acceleration enables large-scale simulations on single and multi-GPU systems
evidence_signal: Reported performance includes BEC RMSE as low as 0.0043 e for BEC-only models and 0.0029 e in multitask models, with energy/force/stress errors of 1.0 meV/atom, 12 meV/angstrom, and 0.05 GPa.
watch_item: BEC scaling is less favorable than energy, force, and stress, and generalization should be checked carefully for structural environments far outside the training distribution.
paper_title: SevenNet-Polar for MultiTask Prediction of Energy, Forces, Stress, and Born Effective Charges: Development and Application to ZrO$_2$, Li$_3$PO$_4$, and Perovskites
